entities.summary: Arab Spring, a transformative movement in Jordan (1999–2015). Emerged from Jordan-Israel peace treaty signed at Wadi Araba and King Hussein renounces Jordan's claim to the West Bank in favor of the PLO. Catalyzed King Abdullah II and Modernization and Abdullah II.
